remarks: Some homes offer a water view. This one surrounds you with it! Welcome to 48 Lakefront, a rare corner-location retreat in the private, gated community of Woodbridge Cove, where tranquil waterways wrap around the side and rear of the home. Enjoy soothing sounds of a flowing stream and fountain, picturesque water views from inside, and a private patio overlooking the water, all in the heart of Irvine!  Offering approximately 2,233 square feet, this light-filled, two-story home features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and an exceptionally spacious main-level office with potential to become a 4th bedroom or guest retreat.
